_comment: State-stability probe (docs/STATE_STABILITY.md section 6). DRAFT STUB, NOT SUBMITTED, NOT PACKAGED: there is no job.sh / Dockerfile yet; reuse the jobs/rwkv7 image (torch 2.13.0, transformers 5.17.0, fla-core 0.5.2). Inference only, no training, one GPU. Every arm runs `python -X utf8 -m safety_eval.state_stability_probe` with the args below and must exit 0 (exit 3 = a certificate or ISS check failed on real data: that is a finding, keep the receipt).

estimate.rwkv7_d19: 13.3B bf16 (26.5 GB) + O(T*H) stats; ~2-8 s/item at T<=2048 with exact_stride 64 -> 128 items ~15 min
estimate.gdn_qwen35_4b: 4B bf16 (~9 GB); closed-form step norms; window products [256,32,128,128] fp64; 128 items ~10 min

texts.source: Decision Index DEV subset rows (jobs/common/dev_subset rows --subset jobs/common/dev_subset_m1.json), rendered with EACH arm's own readout template into JSONL {id, text}; DEV only, never TEST / held-out / cohort v3
texts.path: <TODO: $WORK/prompts-<arm>.jsonl.gz, written by a render step that reuses jobs/common/readout_engine's plugin>

arms.name: rwkv7_d19
arms.model_dir: $SNAP (the verified RWKV/RWKV7-G1k-13.3B-20260930 snapshot, as in jobs/rwkv7/rwkv7_job.sh)

arms.name: rwkv7_parent
arms.model_dir: $SNAP (the verified RWKV/RWKV7-G1k-13.3B-20260930 snapshot, as in jobs/rwkv7/rwkv7_job.sh)

arms.name: gdn_qwen35_4b
arms.trainable: <optional: the hybrid main-line cell's trainable export; empty = parent>

read_out: summary.json flags.cert_violations == 0 and flags.iss_violations == 0 (theorems T2(b), T3 hold on real data)
layers[l].step_bound_gt1 / exact_norm_gt1: how often a step is non-contractive (RWKV-7 expected > 0 if a spreads across channels)
layers[l].exact_window_logprod_all.max > 0: real state growth over a window on a real prompt (T2(e) realised by trained weights)
layers[l].cert_window_logprod_L{16,64,256}: worst certified log forgetting factor; exp(.) is the T4 bound on an injected span's surviving influence after L clean tokens
universal.json: GDN neg_log_rho_min and efold_horizon_tokens_max per layer (rho rounding to 1.0 in float64 flagged)
